services.name: Tandem Skydiving
services.desc: The tandem skydive at Rick's is by far the most popular way to make your first skydive. With minimal ground training, you are able to experience the exhilaration of freefall for nealy 40 seconds. Training will be provided by the instructor that will be accompanying you on your tandem skydive. You will be given the opportunity to pull your own ripcord and help steer the parachute to the ground. Afterwards you will receive a first jump certificate that will be personally signed by your instructor to reflect your accomplishment. After approximately 15-20 minutes of instruction, you and your tandem instructor will climb in the aircraft to an altitude of nearly 2 miles above the earth. Before

blurb: Guests can experience tandem skydiving as a quick way to fly in the sky, train to become licensed skydivers through a first jump course, or join for fun if they are experienced jumpers. The dropzone is located at Petersburg Airport, Ohio, near the Ohio/Pennsylvania border. The business has USPA licensed instructors and over 50,000 combined skydives of experience.
